title: A Day at the Beach
description: Four short recordings about a day at the beach: a plan, a phone message, an ice cream stall and a safety talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Planning the trip
parts.intro: You will hear Minh and Lucy planning a day at the beach.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Minh, the weather is hot tomorrow. Let's go to the beach!

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Great idea. How can we get there?

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: We can go by bus. It takes about forty minutes. The first bus is at eight o'clock.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: That's early! Let's take the next one, at nine.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: OK. What should we bring? I'll bring a big towel and my sunglasses.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I'll bring sun cream, because the sun is strong. And I have a new ball.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Don't forget your swimming shorts!

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Ha, no, I won't. I'm very excited. I love swimming in the sea.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Me too. Let's also take some sandwiches and a bottle of water for lunch.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Good idea. I'll ask my mum to make the sandwiches tonight.

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Sam to his friend Ben.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Hi, Ben. It's Sam. I'm on the beach now. It's lovely here!

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: The water is warm and the sand is very hot. I'm sitting under a big blue umbrella.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: My sister is making a sandcastle, and my dad is reading a newspaper.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I'm sorry, I can't play football with you this afternoon. We are staying here until five o'clock.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Later, we are going to eat fish and chips at a small cafe near the beach. It smells so good!

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: Can we play tomorrow? Call me tonight. Bye!

parts.title: Part 3 · At the ice cream stall
parts.intro: You will hear a girl, Hoa, buying ice cream at the beach.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Hello! Would you like an ice cream?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Yes, please. What flavours do you have?

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: We have chocolate, strawberry and lemon.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: I'd like strawberry, please. And my brother wants chocolate.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Small or large?

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: One small and one large. The small one is for me. How much are they?

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: The small one is two pounds and the large one is three pounds. That's five pounds.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Here is ten pounds.

script.speaker: Seller
script.text: Thank you. Here is your change, five pounds. Enjoy the sunshine!

parts.title: Part 4 · Beach rules
parts.intro: You will hear a lifeguard talking to children on the beach.

script.speaker: Lifeguard
script.text: Hello, children. My name is Kate. I'm the lifeguard, and I want you to be safe today.

script.speaker: Lifeguard
script.text: First, only swim between the two red flags. The sea is safe there.

script.speaker: Lifeguard
script.text: Second, never swim alone. Always swim with a friend or a parent.

script.speaker: Lifeguard
script.text: Third, put on sun cream every two hours, and wear a hat.

script.speaker: Lifeguard
script.text: Finally, please put your rubbish in the bins. We want the beach clean for everyone. Have fun!
